# Élan Summit

> Élan Summit is a premium inter-school event in Pune, Maharashtra, India, held on 5–6 September 2026 at the SGIS Pune Campus, Mulshi (Sanjay Ghodawat International School). It is primarily for school students aged 14 to 19; first-year university students within the same age range are also eligible and may register individually.

Élan's two flagship competitions run at the same time; each participant takes part in one:
- **Crisis Command** — a two-day crisis leadership simulation where mixed-school teams lead a fictional nation through briefing, escalation and a final response.
- **Cent$ible** — an inter-school business arena with four themes (BRAND बनाओ, VIRAL व्यापार, NOTE नीति, प्रश्न PRODIGY), an in-event currency called Cents, and a Boardroom Finale.

Beyond the flagships, Élan includes live performances, competitions, guest sessions, networking, a cultural night and school delegations.

## Accommodation and travel
The Early Bird, Standard and Late Registration passes include accommodation for the night of 5 September and transport in Pune between the accommodation and the venue. The Day Delegate pass (₹2,800) includes neither accommodation nor transport, and is for participants making their own arrangements. Travel to Pune is the participant's own arrangement on every pass. Where accommodation is included, only one night is covered; extra nights can be arranged at additional cost with advance notice.

## Prizes
The winning team in each flagship receives a ₹10,000 cash prize — one for Crisis Command, one for Cent$ible — awarded at the Grand Closing and Awards Ceremony.

## Tickets (https://elansummit.com/tickets)
- Early Bird — ₹3,699 (closed)
- Standard — ₹4,199
- Late Registration — ₹4,899
- Day Delegate — ₹2,800 (no accommodation or transport)
